answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1156 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the marble. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the zephyr queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. The sonnet index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Each impostor pays 9 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
